We started Eclipse with a simple belief that people, their pets, and the team members who care for them deserve something more. It’s time to change the game, and that’s why at Eclipse, world-class is the only standard. In every single thing we do, we believe in building an environment that ensures your pet receives world-class care every step of the way. But here, we don't just care for pets. We care for people. We believe that you should be more deeply involved in your pet's healthcare. In understanding your pet's needs. In understanding the way we think about their health issues. In working closely with both you and your pet's primary veterinarian to make sure they live the longest, happiest, healthiest life possible. It takes a new center of focus. And that center is you. You At The Center Team Member Owned Rethinking veterinary medicine starts with ensuring that the people responsible for patient care have a voice at every level within an organization. At Eclipse, our caregivers are our owners, so decisions are always made based on what is best for our patients, our clients, our community, and our team. This model attracts professionals with incredible talent and a drive to grow, learn, and evolve which is integral to providing world-class care. Team Member Driven At Eclipse our approach is simple: Provide our team with the tools, resources, and environment to do what they do best every day. This means working alongside, listening to, and caring for our team members just as we do our families. Because when you start to reimagine how to care for people, you empower and inspire them to do the same for pets.
